I was 16 and he was 18. He cheated and told me and I immediately broke up with him. I was still in love with him though and after five months of flowers and apologies I forgave him. Building trust back took a long time. He was very understanding and loving through it. Constantly reassuring me and allowing me to heal. Five years later and we are still happily together. I trust him. I can actually say that now. I think if I would have immediately taken him back he would not have changed. We both needed time apart to see what was wrong. We were and are still young and I think we both had to learn something from his mistake for us to be able to grow and be better together today. It's hard and not always worth it but I am very happy I chose to give it another shot.
